detailed_description:
Angular stylised 3D animation, brush-stroke texture, Horsell, Surrey, 1894, daylight from the left, black shadows.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:06. The shot opens on a medium shot on the white flag out over the heather at dusk: the small square of white linen on the top of a long pale pole standing against the deep blue sky, the dark shoulders and hat of the bearer small below it, black heather across the bottom of the picture. The camera is on the heather looking out at the bearer, a 300mm lens. The last of the daylight stands low from the LEFT. At the first frame the square of white linen stands at the CENTRE of the frame just below the TOP third, an eighth of the height of the frame. The pale pole runs down from it to the bearer's dark shoulders and hat at the BOTTOM third, black heather crosses the BOTTOM edge, and the deep blue sky fills the TOP and both edges. The shot is inside this place: Horsell Common at dusk in 1894: knee-deep heather and dark furze reading black, a low raw ring of flung yellow sand round the crater a hundred yards off with a thin jointed mast standing above it. The camera tilts up with large amplitude from the bearer's dark shoulders to the linen at the top of the pole, travelling two long strides as the pole swings over to the right and the linen runs out flat, then hauls back to the left and the linen cracks over, from 00:00 to 00:03. At 00:03 the cord snaps taut where it is lashed and the pole leans a forearm further out over the heather, and the lean continues to the last frame of the shot. By 00:06 the camera is tilting up through the last frame, and the action continues with it.

overall_soundscape: The ambience of Horsell Common at dusk in 1894: knee-deep heather and dark furze reading black runs under the whole take: its own air, the surfaces underfoot and the fabric of the place around it. Cloth, boots and the small sounds of hands on wood, glass and iron carry the physical action throughout.
